title: Typography — Punctuation Spacing, Unit Binding & Short Words

blocks.text: Spacing rules that never break a line in the wrong place

Three rules run over every text run before line breaking. punctuationSpacing: "fr" inserts the narrow no-break space (U+202F) French typography puts before : ; ! ? and the no-break space inside « guillemets » — a registered font is required for the narrow space (the base-14 fonts degrade to the fr-CA preset). unitBinding keeps a number and its unit together with a no-break space, as ISO 80000-1 requires. bindShortWords glues one-letter words to the word that follows.
Sample text — demonstration content in French

Prix : 150 € ; livraison en 48 h ! Vraiment ? Le colis pèse 12 kg et mesure 40 cm × 30 cm ; la température de stockage est de 5 °C à 25 °C. « Une remise de 15 % s'applique dès 3 articles », précise la notice. La vitesse maximale est de 120 km/h ; l'autonomie atteint 400 km à 20 °C.

items: A colon, semicolon, exclamation or question mark never starts a line: the space before it is unbreakable (and narrow).
150 € and 12 kg stay on one line: the space between a figure and its unit is a no-break space.
The one-letter words listed in bindShortWords (à, y, a, l) stay with the following word.
Render again without the typography object to compare the line breaks.
